Notes from Mower County HHS
Keep Your Health Insurance - If you have Medical Assistance or MinnesotaCare, it’s important to keep your contact information updated so Mower County HHS can reach you when it’s time to renew your health insurance. If you’ve moved in the past three years or you will be moving soon, please update your address, phone number and email today by calling 507-437-9700 or email dhsrecep@co.mower.mn.us .

HEALTH & HUMAN SERVICES BOARD
The Mower County Health & Human Services Board generally meets on the second Tuesday of each month.
The Health & Human Services Board consists of 5 members, who are the Mower County Commissioners.
The Mower County Health & Human Services Board powers and duties are as contained in Minnesota Statutes - Chapter 145A Community Health Board.
